parameters.content:
## Fetch queued
Reads all bundles with status QUEUED (optionally only body.bundle_ids). Errors and empty results go straight to the summary.

## Route
Route Guard forces SKIP when the owner opted out or has no Telegram chat. Then: SKIP / STAFF / AUTO_APPLY / SUGGEST+ASK.

## Send one by one
One bundle per loop turn. SUGGEST: Approve / Edit / No thanks. ASK: Closed / Open as usual / Edit. Status becomes SENT only when Telegram confirms. 1.2 s pause per bundle.

## Summary
Counts per route and per result, returned to the webhook caller.

## Lane SKIP
Owner opted out, no Telegram chat or unknown route: mark SKIPPED and log the reason. Nothing is sent.

## Lane STAFF
Needs a human: post the case to the staff chat once. Status stays QUEUED; a STAFF_FLAGGED row in decisions stops repeat alerts.

## Lane AUTO_APPLY (standing permission)
final_hours = proposed_hours for every item, status APPROVED, log, then Apply to Yext. The owner is told afterwards with an Undo button.
